ecological_question: Do survey-time atmospheric moisture and pressure carry information about strong 0-to-CallingIndex-2/3 recruitment beyond rainfall recency, seasonal timing, and temperature?

response.primary: strong_new_score = sum wet CallingIndex for species x stop cells with dry=0 and wet CallingIndex in {2,3}

atmospheric_exposure.source: Earthmover public Icechunk ERA5 single/temporal at the nearest 0.25-degree cell to the mean coordinate of sampled physical SiteIDs in each run.
atmospheric_exposure.time: Nearest hourly ERA5 valid_time to the coordinate-local survey midpoint, converted to UTC.

variables.relative_humidity: Calculated from ERA5 2-m temperature (t2m) and 2-m dewpoint (d2m) with the standard Magnus formula; clipped only for tiny numerical excursions to [0,100].

pair_differences.rh_difference: wetter-run RH minus drier-run RH; positive means more humid during the recent-rain survey.
pair_differences.pressure_difference: wetter-run surface pressure minus drier-run surface pressure.

model.formula: response ~ rain_contrast + temp_difference + doy_difference + year_gap + rh_difference_z + pressure_difference_z + State + RunNumber
model.standardization: RH and pressure pair differences z-scored across the fixed eligible-pair sample; existing rain_contrast remains on its frozen scale.

primary_decisions.rainfall_robustness: rain_contrast coefficient remains >0 with complete 95% CI >0 for strong_new_score.
primary_decisions.humidity_support: rh_difference_z coefficient >0 with complete 95% CI >0 for strong_new_score.
primary_decisions.atmospheric_joint_information: two-degree-of-freedom Wald test of rh_difference_z = pressure_difference_z = 0 has P < 0.05.
primary_decisions.pressure_direction: two-sided descriptive because biological pressure responses can differ among breeding strategies.

secondary.strong_new_count: Repeat identical model; directional corroboration only.
secondary.humidity_only: Model excluding pressure; diagnostic for collinearity.
secondary.pressure_only: Model excluding RH; diagnostic for collinearity.
secondary.exact_consecutive_year: Repeat full model on year_gap==1; directional diagnostic.
secondary.same_observer: Repeat full model on the existing same-observer pair subset intersected with atmospheric eligibility; directional diagnostic.

interpretation.humidity_support_and_rain_remains: Survey-time moisture is an additional proximate cue/context consistent with behavioural activation, but not a causal mediator.
interpretation.joint_support_but_rain_remains: Atmospheric state adds information but does not replace the rainfall-recency association.
interpretation.rain_loses_support: Consistent with atmospheric state accounting for part of the association; still not formal causal mediation because weather variables are observational and contemporaneous.
interpretation.no_atmospheric_support: Recent-rain recruitment is not explained by these two survey-time atmospheric variables; hydrology, hydration history, phenology, or other cues remain plausible.

prohibited: No choosing weather variables after response readback.
No dropping rain_contrast from the primary model.
No RC11 manuscript modification from this exploration.
